faqs.q: Sec. 58-2. - Initiation of prosecution; contents of summonses and complaints.
faqs.a:
(a)
Prosecutions in the municipal court shall be initiated by the:
(1)
Issuance of a summons and complaint; or
(2)
Filing of a complaint following an arrest; or
(3)
Filing of a summons and complaint following arrest.
(b)
Every summons and complaint shall state the name of the defendant, the Code section
               number or ordinance and section number alleged to have been violated, the general
               type of offense to which each such section or ordinance relates, the date and place
               of each alleged violation, that the defendant is known or believed to have committed
               such offense, and that the defendant is required to appear to answer the charges on
               a date and at a time and place designated in the complaint or summons.
(c)
For purposes of this article, police officers, animal management officers, police
               service technicians, police department licensing investigators, parking enforcement
               officers or as designated by the Arvada police chief, building, technical, and zoning
               code enforcement officers, finance department collections agents, and those fire marshals
               appointed by the chief of the city, Coal Creek, or Adams County fire protection district
               and approved by the chief of police of the city as fire arson investigators in the
               city shall be deemed to be peace officers.
(Code 1960, § 1-18; Code 1981, § 18-5; Ord. No. 1850, § 1, 9-7-1982; Ord. No. 2701,
               § 1, 2-5-1990; Ord. No. 3483, § 1, 10-5-1998; Ord. No. 3752, § 1, 6-17-2002;
Ord. No. 4560, § 1, 8-29-2016
)
